name: ResizablePanelGroup
description: Two-or-more-panel layout with pointer and keyboard-accessible resize separators.

ariaRequirements: each panel is a named region
separator exposes aria-orientation, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-26 — named regions, separator value semantics, keyboard resize behavior, and axe result reviewed in unit tests.

dense: horizontal or vertical resizable panel layout; pointer drag, arrow/Home/End keyboard resize, separator value semantics

keyboardStep.description: Keyboard resize increment in percentage points.

forbiddenUse: replace a fixed responsive page grid
allow panels to shrink below usable content minimums

usage.description: Use ResizablePanelGroup for adjacent work areas whose relative space users need to control. Set realistic minimum sizes for every panel.

bestPractices.description: Name every panel region so assistive technology communicates its purpose.
Choose minimum sizes that keep each panel's essential controls usable.
Persist sizes only when restoring the user's workspace is genuinely valuable.
Use a keyboard step that changes layout perceptibly without large jumps.
Do not replace an ordinary responsive page grid with draggable panels.
Do not allow a panel to collapse past the minimum needed by its content.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.description: Named region containing one adjacent workspace.

anatomy.name: Separator
anatomy.description: Focusable resize control between a pair of panels.

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.description: Visible affordance that communicates the separator's drag axis.
